attempts.summary: Built and verified the requested HA monitoring stack. Prometheus replicas on node1/node2 scrape all four hosts; node3 runs Thanos Query on :10902 plus Store and Compact; node4 provides authenticated HTTPS object storage on :9000 with bucket thanos-metrics and persistent data under /srv/thanos-objectstore. Sequential node1 and node2 Prometheus outages preserved current and object-store-backed historical queries, followed by full recovery.
